channel.title: Insider Media Ltd - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Insider Media Ltd (insidermedia.com)

item.title: Developer sought for listed Huddersfield building - residential scheme proposed
item.description: A developer is being sought to undertake a transformation of a grade II*-listed building in Huddersfield.

item.title: South Korean manufacturer launches Midlands base
item.description: A South Korean manufacturer of carbide cutting tools has established a new base in the Midlands after agreeing a deal with commercial property agent Bromwich Hardy.

item.title: Surrey day nursery sold to national operator - Schofield Sweeney advises
item.description: A day nursery in Reigate, Surrey has been acquired by one of the UK's largest nursery groups in a transaction advised by commercial law firm Schofield Sweeney.

item.title: Major expansion of Humber business park set for approval - could create thousands of jobs
item.description: The proposed expansion of a Humber business park that could support the creation of thousands of jobs looks set to get the go-ahead next week.

item.title: Popeyes to open Hull restaurant - first for the chain in East Yorkshire
item.description: Fried chicken brand Popeyes is set to launch in Hull later this month, its first restaurant in the East Riding of Yorkshire.

item.title: Women in Property confirms new Midlands chair
item.description: National networking and influencer organisation Women in Property (WiP) has confirmed its new Midlands branch chair for 2026-27.

item.title: Rapleys unveils Birmingham hires - including new partner
item.description: Rapleys has made two senior planning appointments in its Birmingham office, including a new partner.

item.title: Business leaders welcome Spring Statement stability - "still some key areas which require attention"
item.description: Yorkshire business leaders have welcomed the "stability" offered by Chancellor Rachel Reeves' Spring Statement but said there are "still some key areas which require attention".

item.title: Investment lined up for "jewell" in Hydes' estate
item.description: A landmark dining pub in Cheshire with views across the Dee Estuary to North Wales is set to benefit from a £1.5m investment.

item.title: Professional services remains region's most active sector for dealmaking
item.description: Professional services remained the North West's most active sector by deal volume in 2025, despite a more than 20 per cent year on year decline, according to a report by Experian Market IQ.
